motions.name: broken_1
motions.line: I'm hungryyyyy...

motions.name: broken_2
motions.line: I'm not just a glutton, I take training seriously too. Besides, snacks taste even better after training, hehe.

motions.name: broken_3
motions.line: Wipe out the enemy!

motions.name: broken_4
motions.line: Thank you, I'll train hard!

motions.name: broken_5
motions.line: You broke my button... You won't get away with this!

motions.name: login
motions.line: Fire!

motions.name: login
motions.line: A mission? I'll do my best!

motions.name: touch_1
motions.line: Of COURSE we won! I'm strong, after all.

motions.name: touch_2
motions.line: Just give me meat-filled rice dumplings for my field rations. They're fantastic even if they're cold!

motions.name: touch_3
motions.line: Drown in the ocean of the People's struggle!

motions.name: touch_4
motions.line: Aw, let's eat our fill first before going~

motions.name: touch_5
motions.line: I'm not just a glutton, I take training seriously too. Besides, snacks taste even better after training, hehe.

motions.name: wedding
motions.line: Commander, what are your instructions?<>Huh? You're serious? Did you fall in love with my culinary skills?<>In any case, it's too late for regret now, ahaha! I'm not going to let you go!

motions.name: wedding_touch
motions.line: Commander, as the saying goes, "you can't fight on an empty stomach". Come, I grabbed us an extra lunch box. Let's eat it during our break.
